about: Genus common names (Pierre, 2026-11-07 08:33: "On the genus sheets: some genera have common names. They should be present somewhere."). Only where a widely used one exists, never invented (rule C2); Pierre corrects them in place. from: imr = the IMR fish presentation's sub-entry naming this genus alone (its tag, fish.json genera imr); species = inferred from the common names of the genus's species in the game (IMR reference list, FishBase): every one of them (2 or more) ends in word, and no species of another genus of its family does. Left out: genera whose species share only their family's name (Chaetodon, Acanthurus, Lutjanus, Pterois...), or a name that is the genus name itself (Chromis, Dascyllus, Coris), or a genus with one species here, or its family's general name when it covers the other genera too (Arothron: the tobies are puffers as well). tools/build_fish.py adds common and csrc (the source, in words) to the genus in fish.json and checks each one against its species.
